description: RTL87x3G series (RTL8773GTP, RTL8783GBF), Zephyr watch SDK
notes: vars.flash: nor | nand; vars.chip: rtl8773gtp | rtl8783gbf
For a locally built app, override aa with <app>/bin/app.trace (or the build's fw_out/<chip>/app.trace).
Patch/upperstack traces (ap, aus, pi, spi) are shipped in the SDK trace package, not the SDK itself; add them under 'traces' in the user profile when available.
